description: This file defines data structures and class for managing channel statuses and associated configurations in a messaging application. It primarily contains Codable structs for various messaging platform statuses, accounts, and UI metadata, as well as a singleton class ChannelsStore for state management.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A singleton observable class maintaining the current state of channels, configuration, and related UI data, providing methods for accessing channel metadata and labels.

methods.name: channelMetaEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the UI metadata entry for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a channel ID, prioritizing custom metadata, then labels, then falling back to the ID itself.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailLabel
methods.description: Returns a detailed label for a channel ID, prioritizing custom metadata, then detail labels, then using the general label.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Returns the system image symbol name for a channel ID, prioritizing custom metadata, then stored images, then defaulting to 'message'.

methods.name: orderedChannelIds
methods.description: Returns the list of channel IDs in order, based on metadata or saved order.
